readme.excerpt:
Pinky lets any agent (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Cursor or a script) operate a real iPhone or Android phone over MCP, while you watch on your computer, approve risky steps, take over and review what happened. Approvals are enforced by Pinky's gateway, not by instructions to the agent.

- Every platform. One app for macOS (Apple silicon and Intel), Windows and Linux. It drives Android phones (Android 10 to 17) and iPhones on iOS 17.4 or later: nothing to install on iOS 27 and later, and a helper installed once from Xcode on iOS 17.4 to 26, which you can also choose on iOS 27 (tried there and on Simulators, not yet on a phone below 27; details). - Tiny and native. The window is drawn by MyGo on the GPU, with no Electron and no webview: a 16–22 MB download that idles at about 70 MB of memory and 0% CPU on a Mac. - Any agent, one click. Settings › Agents connects Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Cursor and more, and any agent that can use MCP servers works, on the same computer or over HTTP. - Locked phone? Unlock it from your computer. Save the phone's PIN in Pinky once, then confirm each unlock with Touch ID, Windows Hello or your keyring's password. Agents never see the PIN. - Free and open source under the Apache-2.0 license, with no account to create.

You approve the risky steps. Payments, trades and transfers wait for your click; in Settings › Safety you can have sends, orders, deletions, calls, installs, links that leave the app and settings changes wait too,

items.name: AIHOT
items.description: 一个自己找热点、自己写日报的网站框架。把信源和精选标准换成你的，它就是你的行业热点站。

readme.excerpt:
一个自己找热点、自己写日报的网站框架。 把信源换成你的，把精选标准换成你的 KnowHow，它就是你的行业热点站。

AIHOT 是我做的一个 AI 热点网站。它每天从一批信源里收资料，用大模型先筛一遍、再独立打两次分，挑出真正值得看的，写成中文标题和摘要；把不同来源说的同一件事聚成一个事件，按有多少人在说排出热点；每天早上出一份日报。

这个仓库是它的引擎和框架：网站、后台、精选流程、聚簇和热度算法， 所有提示词的原文和入选门槛 ，都在这里。
features: 我不是专业的开发者。 我是设计师出身，半年前还看不太懂代码。这套代码是我和 AI 一起重写的，比以前干净了很多，但一定还有写得不好的地方。发现问题欢迎提 Issue，我不一定能很快回复，先说声抱歉。
这是 AIHOT 的引擎。 它和 AIHOT 线上跑的是同一份引擎代码，同步时直接从线上导出，不是精心打磨的通用框架。以后 AIHOT 的更新，我会尽量同步过来，但没法保证每一次都同步。模型榜、Codex 重置监控、主题页的大事记这些只对 AI 行业有意义的功能，可安装的 Age
里面没有 AIHOT 的信源名单和运营数据。 仓库带了 18 个公开的海外 AI 资讯源做示范，够你跑起来看效果；真正的信源，要换成你自己行业的。
请不要用 AIHOT 的名字和 Logo。 换上你自己的名字，它就是你的站。

items.name: S2Arm
items.description: Run your own Switch games natively on iPhone, iPad and Mac: game code rewritten to ARM64, graphics direct to Metal, one app for the whole library. Bring your own games and keys. 把你自己的 Switch 游戏原生带到 iPhone / iPad / Mac。

readme.excerpt:
Your own Switch games, running natively on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Game code is rewritten to native ARM64 and runs directly on the device's processor, with graphics going straight to Metal. Your whole library lives in one app, and a few clicks in the Mac or Windows launcher take a game from import to play.

Platforms: iPhone / iPad (iOS / iPadOS 18 and later) · Mac (Apple silicon, macOS 15 and later) · Build on Mac or Windows · Android / HarmonyOS coming soon · License: Apache-2.0 · Bring your own games

简体中文 · Download the launcher · All releases · Evidence

Import your own keys and games. Put the base game, updates and DLC in one folder and import them together.
Choose iPhone / iPad or this Mac, then click Build.
Follow the launcher to sign and install with your own Apple ID (the Windows launcher ships with the Impactor signing tool), open S2Arm, and

items.name: sill
items.description: Any window from your Mac, live on your iPhone or iPad. Touch, Apple Pencil, trackpad and keys. Free, open source, no servers.

readme.excerpt:
Sill shows a window from your Mac, or the whole desktop, on your iPhone or iPad. You use it there with touch, a trackpad, a keyboard or Apple Pencil. Sill for Mac captures the window, encodes it as HEVC video and sends it to the Sill app on your device. Your taps, clicks, scrolls and keys go back to your Mac. Your Mac and your device connect on the same network, over a USB cable, with Direct Wireless Connection when they share no network, or through your own VPN, such as Tailscale, with Remote Access. There is no account and no server in between.

getsill.app · Download for Mac · Support · Privacy · Terms

Sill for Mac is a free, notarized download from getsill.app; with Homebrew, brew install --cask saffsanity/sill/sill installs the same download from Sill's own tap. Sill for iPhone and iPad is free on the App Store, and you can also build it from source (below).
